title: Symptoms and Clinical Signs of Hypogonadism in Testicular Cancer Survivors
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to investigate the prevalence of signs and symptoms of hypogonadism in three groups of testicular cancer survivors.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Earlier treatment of testicular germ cell cancer
* No sign of relapse \> 1 year since latest treatment
* Testosterone \< 12 nmol/L and luteinizing hormone \> 8 IE/L OR
* Testosterone \> 12 nmol/L and LH \> 8 IE/L OR
* Testosterone and LH within their normal ranges

Exclusion Criteria:

* Testosterone substitution
